source: YouTube auto-caption transcript 0:00-24:00 (cut-off 1440 s, nothing after), card names corrected; repeats/related checked against every other analysis/videos/*/ideas.json (pass 3)

ideas.claim: P1p1: with two strong gold outliers in the pack, take the strong multicoloured card and stay willing to move off it.
ideas.quote: when you have like two really strong outliers and power level, it's worth sometimes to just take the strong multicolored card
ideas.test_idea: How often a P1p1 gold card ends up in the final deck; GIH WR of the gold options at P1p1.

ideas.claim: No Admittance is a very strong common (probably the best red common) and worth taking at P1p2 even without a signal.
ideas.quote: This card is a very strong common.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of No Admittance against the P1p2 alternatives; within-deck value by skill group.

ideas.claim: A cheap aggressive red two-drop over the stronger four-drop when the plan is an aggro ping deck and the lane is not yet closed.
ideas.quote: I'm willing to like do a more experimental. Let's see if we can make this deck work as long as it's not looking like too far from being open.
ideas.test_idea: Within-deck value of Battlecarver vs Tetsuko Pursuer in R/x aggro decks.

ideas.claim: Room of Refuge is good in a deck with hard-to-cast gold cards and is somewhat splashable through its four-mana mode.
ideas.quote: Room of Refuge is nice because it helps you cast like really difficult to cast cards like Stinger Quill that need very specific
ideas.test_idea: Deck WR with Room of Refuge for decks holding double-pipped off-colour cards.

ideas.claim: Blossom-Blessed Angel (big flyer) is quite good and the better pick than Thalia, the Survivor or Keeper of the Quiet Hour when white is open.
ideas.quote: Blossom Blessed Angel seems quite good to me. That's just a big flyer.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Blossom-Blessed Angel vs Thalia.

ideas.claim: Abandon the first-pick gold card when its colours are not flowing: no black through five picks, white somewhat open.
ideas.quote: Black does not seem open at all really. White does seem somewhat open.
ideas.test_idea: Drop-off in deck rate of a P1p1 gold card by colours seen in picks 2-5.

ideas.claim: Take the open-colour playable over a speculative card to end up with a functional deck, even when the card (Arni, Humble Scribe) needs a steady stream of creatures to be good.
ideas.quote: I'm not sure how much I like my start for blue though. But I'm just going to take the blue card. I want to end up with a functional deck at the end of the draft.
ideas.test_idea: Deck rate of mid-pack playables in the open colour vs best-card picks.

ideas.claim: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage is good in an attacking deck: flash, deathtouch on a permanent, a counter. It combines with first strike (Skilled Battlecarver) and is in the deck on power level.
ideas.quote: giving my permanence death touch. So if I want to be attacking, that's pretty good.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Teyo in R/B vs other builds; Teyo with first strikers.

ideas.claim: Hallway Heckler over Silence the Echo for the deck: a two-drop that draws and pings, strong when there is a good enchantment to fetch.
ideas.quote: Hallway Heckler seems just like a good card though for my deck.
ideas.test_idea: Within-deck value of Hallway Heckler in R/x decks with 4+ noncreature spells.

ideas.claim: Winter, Team Player fits a deck with both creatures and non-creature spells (convoke, +1/+0 on noncreature spells).
ideas.quote: winter team player seems like a perfect card for this sort of deck because I I'm going to have creatures and I'm gonna have non-creatures
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Winter by creature count and noncreature count.

ideas.claim: A mid-power aggressive creature passed early can wheel in a 14-card pack: Rampart Hunter passed at P1p2 wheels at P1p10.
ideas.quote: Oh, yeah. We could have gotten taken a rampard hunter and we get one anyway.
ideas.test_idea: Wheel rate of mid-power commons from pick k to k+8 in 14-card packs.

ideas.claim: A good two-drop is taken over other cards because good two-drops are scarce in the set.
ideas.quote: I'm glad I took this battle carver though cuz good two drops have been in short supply.
ideas.test_idea: Within-deck value of two-drops by number already held; skill split.

ideas.claim: Take the best gold removal (Vraska, the Cutting Glare) for its upside and plan to splash it only if a landcycler or fixer comes; even in two colours a card like this is worth a splash.
ideas.quote: even if we can't end up splashing it, we still just want to take it because it's such a high upside card
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of a splash card when held vs taken but not played.

ideas.claim: Take the five-damage kill spell over bodies in pack 2 even when red is not the most open colour: 'I do need some kill spells'.
ideas.quote: Yeah, I think I'll take the forte though. I do need some kill spells.
ideas.test_idea: Removal count in 60%+ decks by pick position.

ideas.claim: Take the stronger card first and hope a two-drop wheels from a 12-card pack: Winter at P2p3, Void Extrapolator wheels at P2p11.
ideas.quote: Maybe I can try to wheel this and just take winter.
ideas.test_idea: Wheel rate of cheap commons from pick k to k+8 in 12-card packs.

ideas.claim: Build a direct-damage package (No Admittance, Cast Away Doubt, Way of the Warlord, Hallway Heckler) to enable the non-combat damage payoffs.
ideas.quote: I think like my burn packages coming together of just like direct damage to their face
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of Ingris/Master of Barbs/Grim Repriser by number of noncombat damage sources.

ideas.claim: Take the splash-enabling dual land (Konstrari Annex) over a playable when the pack is thin, because it could enable the Vraska splash.
ideas.quote: I'll just take the land because maybe I could splash the Vasa if I get enough stuff.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of a splash card with 2 vs 1 on-colour fixing lands.

ideas.claim: Pia, Determined Rebuilder is a really good three-drop (2/2 plus a 1/1 flyer) and its arrival is a sign red is open.
ideas.quote: this is a really good pickup and a really good sign for my potential red deck being open
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Pia in R/x decks.

ideas.claim: Terminal Criticism only kills blue or red creatures: a best-of-three card, not one for best of one.
ideas.quote: This card only kills blue or red things, so good in best of three, but not a card I want in best of one.
ideas.test_idea: Deck rate and GIH WR of Terminal Criticism in main decks.

ideas.claim: Prefer Hallway Heckler to Winter, Tormented Loner when there is no good sacrifice fodder in the deck.
ideas.quote: I don't have good stuff to sacrifice really, other than the Pia token, maybe.
ideas.test_idea: Within-deck value of Winter, Tormented Loner by token count.

ideas.claim: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg plus Arni, Humble Scribe is a combo (Arni untaps, Yargle hits for ten) but two bad cards made slightly more playable are not worth playing.
ideas.quote: sometimes you don't want to play two bad cards to make them both slightly more playable
ideas.test_idea: Win rate when both cards are in the main deck.

ideas.claim: At the end of pack 2 he counts his playables (22 in the deck) so pack 3 only has to fill a few needs.
ideas.quote: My deck currently has 22 cards in it, including these three. So, I only need a few things for pack three.
ideas.test_idea: Playables held after pack 2 vs deck win rate.

ideas.claim: Lich's Relic (kill spell plus equipment) over Samut, Hazoret's Champion because the winters make team haste worth less; Eye of Ugin does nothing in this format and Charge the Sanctum is replaced by better effects.
ideas.quote: I don't really value it quite as highly because like if I'm going to convoke out
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Lich's Relic vs Samut; synergy with Winter.

ideas.claim: Stingerquill Charm is the perfect card for the deck: a kill spell, a two-drop or a combat trick.
ideas.quote: It's another kill spell or another two drop or a combat trick. So just the perfect card for me.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Stingerquill Charm in B/R.

ideas.claim: Two-drops do not wheel because other drafters also want them: take Grim Repriser now over a 3/3 prowess for three and a land.
ideas.quote: I'm not going to be able to wheel this card cuz other players I think are also in demand for two drops.
ideas.test_idea: Wheel rate of two-drops vs other cards of equal rating.

ideas.claim: Vraska drops out of the deck without a basic landcycler: a random Forest is not worth it, and tapped lands are a cost in an aggro deck.
ideas.quote: I don't want to just put a random forest in my deck as much if I can't like search it up as well because it is a downside to have tap lands in your aggro deck
ideas.test_idea: Splash success by number of landcyclers and fixing lands; tapped-land penalty in aggro.

ideas.claim: Speculative picks are free when they were not taken over anything good for the deck.
ideas.quote: I don't regret the farasa and the lands were pretty free when I took them. I didn't take them over anything great for my deck.
ideas.test_idea: Hard to test; process note.

ideas.claim: Master of Barbs (noncombat-damage anthem) over a second Fulminous Forte and the dual land: it turns the pings from Hallway Heckler and Ingris into pump.
ideas.quote: Whenever one of our opponents are dealt non-combat damage creatures you control get plus and plus O until end of turn
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Master of Barbs by noncombat damage source count.

ideas.claim: Take the five-damage Fulminous Forte over Way of the Warlord and expect the Warlord to wheel; it does one pick later. Plays two Warlords, not three.
ideas.quote: I get kind of immediately rewarded for my decision because now I get a way of the warlord.
ideas.test_idea: How often the second-best removal spell wheels in 8-card packs.

ideas.claim: Ferocity of the Hunt works with first strikers: death touch plus first strike makes a creature nearly unblockable.
ideas.quote: Death touch and first strike makes it pretty much unblockable.
ideas.test_idea: Ferocity GIH WR by first-strike creature count.

ideas.claim: A last-pick on-colour dual land is very valuable for a deck with restrictive colour requirements; he would not take it earlier before the colours were settled.
ideas.quote: last pick black red land for my black red deck is so good, especially with what my restrictive color requirements on some of my stuff.
ideas.test_idea: Land WR value by pick position.

ideas.claim: Do not splash Vraska in a fast aggro deck even with the sources, because a team buff and cheap curve matter more.
ideas.quote: I probably could try to splash this, but I think my deck is just pretty aggressive.
ideas.test_idea: Mock deck WR with and without a splash for aggro builds.

ideas.claim: Build technique: cut every card and add back the premium cards first (removal, two-drops, signature gold), then fill the creature count; adding cards over time helps.
ideas.quote: you can just kind of cut every card from your deck and then add in the cards you know you want to play
ideas.test_idea: Hard to test; process note.

ideas.claim: Seven two-drops is the target: one Void Extrapolator on top of the six others; eight might be a bit much.
ideas.quote: I think eight might be a bit much.
ideas.test_idea: Deck WR by two-drop count.

ideas.claim: Bias the manabase towards the heavier colour: an extra Mountain over a Swamp (9 Mountain, 7 Swamp, one dual).
ideas.quote: maybe I should just play like an extra mountain over a swamp
ideas.test_idea: Basic split vs colour pip weight; mock deck WR.

ideas.claim: Fill the last slots with the creature that has an effect (second Hallway Heckler) over Artifist Acumen and Cast Away Doubt.
ideas.quote: I'd rather just play I think hallway heckler in that role.
ideas.test_idea: Hard to test; process note.
